scope: Unexecuted game acceptance requirements. SPEC_VALIDATION.json reports only document checks; it never changes these statuses.

cases.title: Reproduce the current native baseline
cases.requirement: The actual repository, branch, dirty files, executable, seed/save, dependencies, and source ownership are recorded; prior reported status is not substituted for inspection.

cases.title: Clean checkout and asset dependencies
cases.requirement: All required owned source and original asset inputs are tracked/reproducible; unrelated work is untouched and no hidden local file is required.

cases.title: Existing save migration and rollback safety
cases.requirement: Backups and migrations preserve canonical entities, construction, quantities, and versions; an incompatible migration fails safely without silent regeneration.

cases.title: Authored asset to native interaction
cases.requirement: An original authored item retains editable source, scale, pivots, materials, collider/ports and import provenance, and is inspected while used in the native game.

cases.title: Completion report truthfulness
cases.requirement: Implemented, unit-tested, native-observed, playtested and performance-validated are reported separately; failed/unavailable checks and placeholders remain visible.

cases.title: Purpose-isolated deterministic generation
cases.requirement: Same manifest produces the same canonical results across visit orders and worker schedules; adding cosmetic decoration does not move rivers, settlements or deposits.

cases.title: Planetary seam and pole traversal
cases.requirement: Terrain, gravity, ownership, roads, drainage and saved edits remain continuous at all supported region-face seams and exceptional topology locations.

cases.title: Shared map, terrain and orbit facts
cases.requirement: All representations use the same body parameters and canonical geography; changing camera scale does not create another mutable world.

cases.title: Coherent geology and connected water
cases.requirement: The default fixture contains explained lithology, catchments, outlets, strata, springs and actual volumetric openings; refinement preserves macro boundaries.

cases.title: High-precision frame round trip
cases.requirement: At large system coordinates, frame transforms preserve declared player-scale tolerance, rotation and point velocity without early f32 truncation.

cases.title: Operation identity through retries and compaction
cases.requirement: Duplicate requests, reconnect, journal compaction and expired receipt detail never repeat a successful cost, reward, transfer or damage event.

cases.title: Crash injection at transaction boundaries
cases.requirement: Interrupt before/after activation, persistence and receipt; restore one coherent allowed state and correct Applied-versus-Durable semantics.

cases.title: Stale derived publication
cases.requirement: Old mesh, collision, navigation, light or proxy results cannot overwrite newer relevant source projections; unrelated inventory changes do not force full rebuilds.

cases.title: Mutable overlays and changed generators
cases.requirement: A world upgrade preserves installed geography, sites, identities, recorded knowledge and player edits; caches can be rebuilt without rewriting canon.

cases.title: Indexed resume after long play
cases.requirement: Saved entry reads a current indexed state plus bounded suffix, not full history or global erosion; genuine collision-ready first interaction is measured.

cases.title: Default-preset freeze reproduction
cases.requirement: Capture the actual failing timeline and isolate CPU work, GPU work, memory pressure, waits, pipeline compilation or driver causes before claiming a fix.

cases.title: Whole-job peak admission
cases.requirement: Saturate producers and stall GPU completion; descriptors, ready outputs, staging and retirements plateau within declared credits without deadlock.

cases.title: Cancellation and stale completion
cases.requirement: Cancel before/after encoding, supersede a region repeatedly, and reuse handles; no premature reclaim, leaked staging, dropped completion or double release.

cases.title: Minimize, resize and device epoch
cases.requirement: Rapid resize/minimize and simulated device recovery keep authority state intact; transitions are bounded, zero-size surfaces handled, and cleanup makes progress.

cases.title: Native budget pressure and pool backing
cases.requirement: Lower available budget during replacement; optional admission stops, real backing or reuse is demonstrated, and essential correct geometry remains available.

cases.title: Coarse-fine seams and edited holes
cases.requirement: Traverse edge/corner transitions with caves, fine railings, bridges and destroyed landmarks; no sky leaks, filled tunnels, overlap flicker or restored distant tower.

cases.title: LOD publication frontier
cases.requirement: Delay arbitrary child uploads and empty results; the published frontier keeps complete valid coverage, bounded transitions and no unbounded neighbor-refinement cascade.

cases.title: Occlusion after cover removal
cases.requirement: Remove a wall, move occluders and turn rapidly at non-power-of-two resolutions; compare with unculled output and detect no false hidden actor or stale cover.

cases.title: Shadow and depth correctness
cases.requirement: Near/far casters, moving fragments, foliage and interiors use correct depth/bias/material behavior without broad black patches or missing geometry.

cases.title: Art identity at actual camera scales
cases.requirement: Matched native day/night/motion captures show coherent silhouettes, pixel clusters, distinct materials, grouped plants, quiet spaces and accessible original architecture.

cases.title: Fast travel and turnaround
cases.requirement: Move at supported speed toward an uncached site and reverse; collision/readiness deadlines, upload age and memory remain bounded without missing ground.

cases.title: Persistent surface complexity
cases.requirement: Compare solid, hollow, checkerboard, perforated and material-fragmented regions at equal voxel count; measure real output/collision/memory costs and preserve supported geometry.

cases.title: Cross-machine command replay
cases.requirement: On the declared compatibility profile, accepted commands reproduce complete canonical state across machines, worker counts and render rates without routine corrective state traffic.

cases.title: Complete checkpoint continuation
cases.requirement: Restore terrain, solver/cache, controller, RNG, material and attachment state; continued hashes match an uninterrupted run, not merely object poses.

cases.title: A deliberately stalled client
cases.requirement: Host and other peers continue; the stalled peer exhausts bounded prediction then recovers or receives an explicit readiness result, without global waiting.

cases.title: Missing commands and sealed ticks
cases.requirement: Reorder/drop accepted frames and no-event ranges; confirmed time never passes a gap, axes follow bounded hold policy, and one-shot actions never repeat.

cases.title: Immediate break and dependent movement
cases.requirement: A predicted hole, selection ray, local motion and crate contacts use the same branch; authority rejection restores coherent dependencies without overwriting others edits.

cases.title: Target generation contention
cases.requirement: Two players mine/replace one cell; only one gets original loot and a late request cannot destroy a newly placed unrelated machine at the same coordinate.

cases.title: Receipt before canonical patch
cases.requirement: Receipt/data arrival orders never flash a wall back, spend provisional loot, duplicate sound, or discard unresolved dependent actions.

cases.title: Baseline capture versus compaction
cases.requirement: Race snapshot publication and suffix pinning with edits/compaction; every committed event remains represented exactly once.

cases.title: Late baseline versus newer live state
cases.requirement: Old epochs and same-epoch stale candidates cannot regress the installed frontier or overwrite newer geometry.

cases.title: Bulk transfer saturation
cases.requirement: First join, repair and content transfer under limited upload do not starve controls/receipts; queued bytes, age and processing cost are bounded.

cases.title: Domain merge, split and mode transition
cases.requirement: Before physical coupling, install a coherent merged baseline; splitting and fallback preserve contacts, momentum, frames, caches and ownership under tested rules.

cases.title: Hidden information boundary
cases.requirement: Portal interest and domain membership reveal only authorized facts; exact-mode convenience does not expose secret inventories or undiscovered private structures.

cases.title: Changed-cover combat policy
cases.requirement: Test accepted/rejected break-then-shot, replacement blocks, current new cover, moving doors, exhausted history and duplicate fire; authority selects one damage/cost outcome.

cases.title: Impairment and full traffic accounting
cases.requirement: Configured RTT, asymmetry, loss, burst loss, reorder, duplication and relay migration converge within declared limits; report complete traffic, state age, corrections and replay costs.

cases.title: One material owner through fracture
cases.requirement: Cut a structure and collect fragments; original terrain, debris, salvage and inventory never own the same quantity twice.

cases.title: Load versus connectivity
cases.requirement: Connected but overloaded construction can fail under the defined model; unknown unloaded support is not automatically detached or a certified anchor.

cases.title: Support deletion with cyclic and cross-brick bonds
cases.requirement: Repeated cuts and moving attachments yield correct bounded component work, mass/inertia, point velocities, cargo and collider publication.

cases.title: Heated tank, powered hinge and floating crate
cases.requirement: Breach the tank while inlet and obstacle move; real flow, pressure, heat and two-way impulses operate once within declared numerical tolerances.

cases.title: Fluid boundary activation/deactivation
cases.requirement: Across active/inactive or adjacent patches, preserve mass/composition/heat/motion as supported; no invisible drain/wall, duplicated flux or camera-dependent disappearance.

cases.title: Freeze, cable support and melt
cases.requirement: Freeze flowing water around a cable, load/cut it and melt it; latent heat, fluid/solid ownership, tension and collision remain coherent.

cases.title: Grains on belt, settling and reload
cases.requirement: Transport, settle, save, reopen and excavate material without a body per grain, duplicated quantity or reset provenance.

cases.title: Fast projectile and rotating thin cover
cases.requirement: Swept contacts use the correct revised geometry for both moving participants; render approximation does not grant tunneling or phantom obstruction.

cases.title: Dense contact and wake amplification
cases.requirement: Converge existing bodies, alter gravity near sleepers and drive joint loops; common physics stays correct with measured contacts/constraints and no private accuracy reduction.

cases.title: Already admitted impact under pressure
cases.requirement: After projectile activation, saturate derived queues; reserved effects and costs occur once at the defined stage/tick rather than disappearing or being indefinitely delayed.

cases.title: Tool-family functional loop
cases.requirement: Actual mine/build/hoe/harvest/bucket/shear/fish/ignite/map/repair affordances use correct tags, feedback and authoritative results, not inventory icons only.

cases.title: Mixed-resolution construction
cases.requirement: Place, rotate, remove and repair supported fine shapes on large cells; collision/selection/quantity and seam behavior agree.

cases.title: Blueprint, mirror and creative distinctions
cases.requirement: Ghosts show real fit/resources; survival consumes once, creative sources are labeled, undo respects ownership, and construction does not steal neighbouring structures.

cases.title: Stack, sort and consolidate
cases.requirement: Repeated sorting/stacking preserves lot compatibility, quality, identity/quantity and locked/favourite slots across saves and concurrent edits.

cases.title: Storage scanner permissions and movement
cases.requirement: Incremental index follows container moves, locks, range/connections and destruction without full-world scans or access to private containers.

cases.title: Concurrent last-item crafting/withdrawal
cases.requirement: Exactly one valid transaction acquires the final input; duplicate ingredients/overflow/partial capacity are handled without partial unrecorded consumption.

cases.title: Comfort without late-game gates
cases.requirement: A fresh survival fixture provides useful storage, shelter, food/light and simple work without compulsory boss kills, slaughter, AFK or advanced-chip fabrication.

cases.title: Material recovery and process lots
cases.requirement: Alternate ore routes change recovery/purity/byproducts while conserving represented feedstock and inputs; reload does not reroll yield.

cases.title: Circuit and storage limits
cases.requirement: Closed DC network, resistance/heating, source/provider/port limits and capacitor behavior agree with the declared model; large capacity does not grant unlimited power.

cases.title: Conversion and thermal loops
cases.requirement: Converters, electrolysis/fuel-cell or equivalent loop, pumps, heat exchange and cooling cannot create free energy through missing losses or erased heat.

cases.title: Interrupted or blocked production
cases.requirement: Stop power, fill output, change a valve and save mid-stage; quantities and partial state remain coherent with useful player-facing diagnoses.

cases.title: Deterministic wake scheduling
cases.requirement: Two networks wake one consumer, reused entities and canceled events; no duplicate activation/transfer and no unbounded stale scheduler storage.

cases.title: Dormant factory oracle comparison
cases.requirement: Coarse/batched advancement matches the defined tick model through thresholds and interruptions; broken logistics and blocked outputs do not produce offline goods.

cases.title: Functional multilayer IC
cases.requirement: Two distinct layouts show different real IO/memory/control/throughput behavior with test-bench diagnostics; design save, manufacture and installation preserve function.

cases.title: Complete useful product chain
cases.requirement: Prospect or salvage, process, fabricate a controller, power/automate a pump and improve a place; statistics expose actual throughput, losses, quality and bottlenecks.

cases.title: Wand compiler limits and order
cases.requirement: Deck order/shuffle, triggers, cost, delay and modifier composition behave as declared; recursive expansion is bounded and errors are understandable.

cases.title: Earthfold physical closure
cases.requirement: Donor material becomes constrained panels with actual voids/collision, force limits and occupant handling; payload activation follows real supported closure state.

cases.title: Mining spell exclusive yield destination
cases.requirement: Hammerhand/additional heads and output modifiers perform paid work; debris/store/transmute/XP paths cannot duplicate the same resource.

cases.title: Cultivated creature and size change
cases.requirement: An actual organism gains supported behavior, anatomy/collider/mass or explicit magic-source changes and persistent identity, not only a scaled visual.

cases.title: Dark spell anchor and alternatives
cases.requirement: A restricted technique uses discoverable dependencies and effective counters; consent and legitimate alternatives matter, not just a purple damage type.

cases.title: Unreturned bounded knowledge
cases.requirement: Only allowed observations/anchors influence behavior; reload and networking preserve limits, respite and ownership without omniscient inventory counters.

cases.title: Unreturned resolution and safe home
cases.requirement: Supported investigative/resolution path works; wards and uninvolved co-op players remain protected, with no fake chat or offscreen storage deletion.

cases.title: First-person equipment quality
cases.requirement: Original held wand/tool has useful grip, scale, animation, cast origin and coherent world/icon appearance; native use is reviewed rather than inferred from Blender output.

cases.title: Coarse-to-detailed resident and cargo
cases.requirement: Repeated activation of adjacent districts refines one household/journey/consignment, never duplicates stock or overlaps abstract and physical work.

cases.title: Friendly daily life and habitat
cases.requirement: Different supported body plans can reach home/work/services; organisms follow habitat and ordinary routines without meal-by-meal micromanagement.

cases.title: Wizard compound alternate access
cases.requirement: Public work, restricted rooms, service routes and actual containment exist; research/trade/service/infiltration have distinct consequences and alarms do not instantly fail the site.

cases.title: City growth and player ownership
cases.requirement: New construction respects plots, resources, access and player edits; no overnight overwrite or visit-order reroll.

cases.title: Radio and scheduled delivery
cases.requirement: Broadcast/map information has a real source/window/uncertainty and authorized destination; missed windows have supported alternatives rather than permanent ordinary lockout.

cases.title: Consignment custody through transport
cases.requirement: Warehouse, carrier, coarse travel, pod, dock and recipient transfer one recorded cargo identity; disconnect/reload cannot award it twice.

cases.title: Peaceful settlement viability
cases.requirement: Hospitality, trade, restoration, gardens and specialist work create real benefits; prosperity does not mandate endless escalating raids or city-government chores.

cases.title: Complete first journey and return
cases.requirement: Stream/embankment/gallery loop offers visible invitation, several approaches, evidence, optional action/understanding, quiet discovery and a meaningful return.

cases.title: Player-created alternate route
cases.requirement: Digging, building, gliding or another supported bypass discovers a coherent site and valid clues rather than broken scripting or blanket immunity.

cases.title: Physical puzzle consistency
cases.requirement: At least one pressure/gravity/false-wall/fold interaction uses real state and multiple solutions with legible consequences, not hidden matching-key flags.

cases.title: Knowledge provenance and reconstruction
cases.requirement: Observed/reported/inferred/tested records retain source/time; clues and old maps do not become omniscient exact markers or reroll on visit order.

cases.title: Quiet exploration and accessible guidance
cases.requirement: A view/person/specimen is worthwhile without obligatory loot/combat; optional guidance supports players who cannot rely on subtle sound or color.

cases.title: Boss and enemy readability
cases.requirement: Distinct roles, telegraphs, recovery, paths and actual counterplay work alone and in co-op; damage persists and no instant input-reading defeats clever methods.

cases.title: Farming and restoration persistence
cases.requirement: Supported ecosystem/ritual resets have real costs/population/provenance; repaired routes and player changes remain useful without duplicate experience/material.

cases.title: Multi-family realm policy
cases.requirement: Universe family, realm, body and frame remain separate; direct requests cannot forge discovery/private permissions or restricted cross-family travel.

cases.title: Crimson pocket isolation
cases.requirement: Local travel and valid paired return work; ordinary flight or ordinary forged portals cannot connect different Crimson planet pockets.

cases.title: Null Choir revised rule
cases.requirement: An ordinary electrical machine continues functioning while a sustained magical binding attenuates; material fire and unsupported magical structures follow distinct rules.

cases.title: Static arbitrary portal orientation
cases.requirement: Position, direction, orientation and handedness map correctly for nonparallel apertures and different gravity frames.

cases.title: Moving endpoints and point velocity
cases.requirement: Rotating/translating source and destination preserve intended portal-relative motion, angular state and explicit energy accounting without giant accidental orbital impulses.

cases.title: Native visible doorway and mid-crossing view
cases.requirement: Parallax, near-plane behavior, occlusion and clipped actors work from oblique angles and halfway through, with no black frame, fake screenshot or source fog contamination.

cases.title: Destination not ready or unauthorized
cases.requirement: Pending aperture is visibly blocked; preview sends no private data and traversal waits only for that valid transfer rather than pausing every player.

cases.title: Opposite crossings, disconnect and replay
cases.requirement: Simultaneous travelers and retries at the exact transfer tick produce one entity/cargo owner each and a consistent save/reload result.

cases.title: Nested portal and coupled-effect limits
cases.requirement: Recursion/render-target/interest budgets are bounded; closed-while-occupied and unsupported ropes/fluid/networks follow explicit policies rather than deletion or hidden fake continuity.

cases.title: Remote edits and players through a portal
cases.requirement: Two clients see actual destination movement and current terrain; source/destination view histories and authoritative interest remain coherent during editing and recovery.

cases.title: Creative category and editable starter
cases.requirement: Spacecraft & Space Building contains functional parts/blueprints; Kestrel can be edited and built from the same survival-compatible kit.

cases.title: Assembly boundary and stable identity
cases.requirement: Launching/staging/landing never swaps to an unrelated prefab, carries the hangar, duplicates hulls or loses module/cargo ownership.

cases.title: Airtightness actual geometry
cases.requirement: Thin walls, corners, windows, partial shapes and fine/coarse joints produce correct seal/leak diagnostics; a missing canopy corner cannot be concealed by a seat bubble.

cases.title: Compartment split, merge and equalization
cases.requirement: Hatches, breaches, docking and moving volumes conserve gas/enthalpy under the model; unknown topology never certifies safety and closing a door does not refill a room.

cases.title: Life support and thermal state
cases.requirement: Separate pressure/composition, scrubber, power, heat and supplies persist during travel/unload; breach is repairable and a suit enables declared contingency behavior.

cases.title: Aero, actuator and load diagnostics
cases.requirement: Wings require usable airflow/exposure, actuators and finite power; mass/fuel/cargo changes affect steering; vacuum-only craft need no decorative wing blocks.

cases.title: Real propulsion and guidance
cases.requirement: Installed engines consume finite actual supplies and guidance uses available control authority; insufficient capability is diagnosed rather than corrected by free forces.

cases.title: Altitude versus orbit and round trip
cases.requirement: A returning arc and stable orbit are distinguished; launch, insertion, rendezvous, deorbit, entry and landing use one consistent configured model without unlabeled cheats.

cases.title: Walking passengers on moving ship
cases.requirement: Clients can walk/drop objects during translation, rotation, acceleration and correction with coherent collision time and no double deck velocity or lost passengers.

cases.title: Dock, service, disconnect and depart
cases.requirement: Compatible capture/permissions/seals/equalization precede opening; both vessel identities and all inventory survive repeat docking and restart.

cases.title: Station construction and skyhook fit
cases.requirement: A built station needs supported orbital state; tether/elevator/transfer geometry has explicit eligibility, load/clearance and schedule rather than a generic hovering prop.

cases.title: First useful orbital return and vehicle portal
cases.requirement: A real platform mission returns useful cargo to the same workshop; a supported fitting ship can transfer through a legal portal with crew/compartments intact and no Crimson loophole.

cases.title: Original hanging machine-city composition
cases.requirement: Approach/interior/reverse/distant native views establish scale, voids, original structures and useful space; no generic castle or copied finale geometry.

cases.title: Independent route families
cases.requirement: Foundry, vertical machinery/choir and underworks offer distinct routes and systemic choices; damaged paths and player construction remain coherent.

cases.title: Warden functional counterplay
cases.requirement: Each completed warden has readable combat and at least one real environmental/engineering intervention tied to functioning machinery, not just a switch counter.

cases.title: Any two of four progression
cases.requirement: All valid orders and co-op joins persist correctly; remaining wardens affect the King through declared systems and no client can forge the shared state.

cases.title: King combat and realignment
cases.requirement: Fair telegraphs, actual hit volumes, dynamic routes, player-built interventions and persistence work without arbitrary immunity or deleting the players tools.

cases.title: Extraction and reconnect
cases.requirement: Multiple supported exit/rescue paths preserve participants through disconnect and failure; pre-victory return is available and ordinary possessions are not wiped.

cases.title: Charted nexus and replay-safe farming
cases.requirement: Successful extraction unlocks only authorized discovered edges; return visits/reset costs/rewards preserve identity, avoid duplicate loot and do not erase the whole location.

cases.title: Four simultaneous player intentions
cases.requirement: Explorer, factory operator, fighter/builder and joining player share the actual inhabited world under impairment and forced relay with bounded state age and queues.

cases.title: Long-run memory and recovery
cases.requirement: Travel, edits, plants, scripts, saves, frames, portals and vehicles stop growing retained state after expected steady demand; post-burst debt drains under continued normal use.

cases.title: Reduced visual quality and accessibility
cases.requirement: Lower effects/resolution/detail preserve collision, hazards, clues, cover, material distinction and operable UI; color/sound-only dependencies have alternatives.

cases.title: Current world at every representation
cases.requirement: Globe, far skyline, near terrain, interior, vehicle frame, portal view and reload agree on consequential edits and identities through extended play.

cases.title: Honest finished-slice delivery
cases.requirement: Provide original code/assets, executable native procedures, observed failures, measured comparisons and remaining scope; no synthetic screenshot or unrun test presented as proof.

cases.title: Scope before patch
cases.requirement: One selected bounded proof names actual source owners, allowed changes, native steps and stop condition; no unrelated subsystem rewrite.

cases.title: Correctness before cosmetic diagnosis
cases.requirement: A suspicious dark region is separated into geometry/depth, CSM, distant visibility and final radiance before any asserted root cause.

cases.title: No invented terrain fallback
cases.requirement: Known cave/arch and edited openings remain open through delayed child uploads; unknown state does not become fabricated solid terrain.

cases.title: Shadow domain overlap
cases.requirement: Valid distant and near blockers remain effective; no max/average/min change passes solely because it makes an artifact lighter.

cases.title: Shader semantic layout
cases.requirement: Material kind/flags, host layouts and shared declarations are checked in current source; any formerly overloaded family ID has explicit supported meaning.

cases.title: Ground identity without labels
cases.requirement: Bedrock, sediment, bare soil and maintained ground differ through appropriate shape/edges/use; native unlabeled scenes are understandable beyond green-gray color masks.

cases.title: Terrain mass hierarchy
cases.requirement: Ordinary uncurated clay views show connected masses/ridges/valleys and quiet sections; new peak noise alone is insufficient.

cases.title: Geological counterfactual
cases.requirement: Alter lithology or hydraulic connectivity in a disposable fixture; valid cave/spring/habitat/excavation consequences differ without rerolling runtime worlds.

cases.title: Regional schedule independence
cases.requirement: Generation order, worker count and cosmetic content streams preserve immutable geological/river/site identities under the same manifest.

cases.title: Fine-edit amount invariance
cases.requirement: Equivalent physical removed/placed volumes across supported cell sizes preserve material accounting and rounding remainder under repeated edits.

cases.title: Botanical anatomy and origin
cases.requirement: One fern/shrub has coherent attachment, recognizable form and actual production source; a procedural blob or unexecuted script does not pass native art review.

cases.title: Specimen identity under recruitment
cases.requirement: Adding seedlings or changing cohort membership does not move/reidentify existing harvested or protected plants; reload preserves modifications.

cases.title: Ecology open-system balance
cases.requirement: Growth ledger declares environmental material/energy inputs and outputs; promotion/demotion alone changes no harvestable biomass or stock.

cases.title: Foliage coverage and motion
cases.requirement: Near-to-far plant coverage preserves recognizable crowns without detached trunks, uncontrolled alpha overdraw or significant camera-dependent flicker.

cases.title: Construction-kit parity
cases.requirement: Player-accessible roof/door/frame interfaces reproduce the promised visual language; site access and structure work from reverse/ground-level approaches.

cases.title: Building condition is legible
cases.requirement: Intact/ruined/repaired state has structural and usage evidence, not arbitrary missing walls beside pristine surfaces.

cases.title: Early convenience playtest
cases.requirement: Fresh builder/explorer can obtain useful storage and tools without boss completion, forced factory, hostile grinder or external tutorial; observed friction is recorded.

cases.title: Death recovery trial
cases.requirement: Repeated failures do not create default permanent fragility/gear-loss spiral; recovery has understandable stakes and voluntary experimentation remains viable.

cases.title: Offscreen autonomy parity
cases.requirement: Same functioning factory receives the same elapsed simulation and real inputs while owner explores versus stands nearby; comparable outcomes follow the declared reduced model.

cases.title: Heat-pump source accounting
cases.requirement: Thermal output, environmental extraction and electrical work reconcile; a useful coefficient of performance is not confused with closed-loop free energy.

cases.title: Discovery without forced human trigger
cases.requirement: Sensors/drones can perform supported observations; UI only reveals legitimately obtained facts and distinguishes generated knowledge from inaccessible private state.

cases.title: Guidance is optional and factual
cases.requirement: Help can be disabled or requested; it explains known next actions without inventing an event, source, buried reward or mandatory objective.

cases.title: Familiarity versus stale repetition
cases.requirement: Playtest ordinary building/production/travel and record unwanted repetition without treating all recognizable motifs or quiet sessions as failure.

cases.title: Accessible cue redundancy
cases.requirement: A required clue/operational signal is not solely color, tiny pixels, sound or flashing; alternate supported cues preserve the same knowledge.

cases.title: Seed secrecy boundary
cases.requirement: Security review explicitly distinguishes reconstructible generated geography from protected mutable inventories/claims; shared seed is not asserted to prevent datamining.

cases.title: Partial proof does not finish a feature
cases.requirement: Tether visual acceptance never marks cargo/orbit ready; moving assembly never marks orbital return ready; only the selected proof and its evidenced cases change status.

cases.title: Task prerequisite independence
cases.requirement: A local encounter or art correction is not blocked by unrelated new gliding, fab, civilization or fluid systems; required behaviors can come from proven existing code.

cases.title: Subpixel tether compositing
cases.requirement: A narrow/widened tether displays against land, cloud and sky without opaque background erasure; motion and crossings preserve projected coverage and depth policy.

cases.title: Matched visual evidence
cases.requirement: Before/after record same save, seed, camera, exposure/settings and build identity plus motion; any changed conditions are disclosed.

cases.title: First-person construction framing
cases.requirement: Held material is identifiable without unnecessarily obscuring placement target/scene; viewport/FOV/movement and other-player representation are checked.

cases.title: Production provenance and tool reality
cases.requirement: Authored sources/imports/licences are recorded; executed Blender or asset tools have real outputs; unsupported formats/tools are marked blocked, not claimed.

cases.title: Supported overload retains accepted effects
cases.requirement: When work queues saturate, already admitted damage/transfers occur under declared staged semantics; optional presentation is shed without deleting reality.

cases.title: Capability diversity without compulsory curriculum
cases.requirement: An advanced system provides useful presets and alternative acquisition/use paths; ordinary house/expedition play does not require every industrial discipline.

cases.title: Ordinary place without forced spectacle
cases.requirement: Remove lore labels, special-event scripts and quest markers in a test copy; ordinary movement/building/observation remains worthwhile to sampled players.

cases.title: Two-client proof before planetary multiplication
cases.requirement: Early shared crate/edit/local physics/reconnect evidence exists; low routine traffic is not claimed from a seed or localhost connection alone.

cases.title: Second-world mechanical difference
cases.requirement: Transport existing equipment to a different environment; at least one meaningful changed decision and valid return are observed, not just a palette or crafting lock.

cases.title: Cultural/editorial integrity
cases.requirement: Culture, body plan, job and morality remain separate; source-specific folklore is reviewed with appropriate expertise before final direct portrayal, and origin need not be explained away as machinery.

cases.title: No environmental global freeze
cases.requirement: A deliberately stalled client, renderer minimization or device recovery does not erase listen-host state or freeze other supported players; retained work and retirement stay bounded.
